description: Makes OMP verification budgets durable and task-aware and upgrades legacy Lite profiles during update
changelog:
**Bounded verification that survives reloads:**
- Persists OMP V/U counters per session and canonical active task, with independent code and UI buckets.
- Adds user-only one-shot `/trellis-authorize-verification code|ui` commands after exhaustion; V0/U0 and the selected UI driver remain absolute boundaries.
- Classifies actual common verification commands instead of charging searches or prose that merely mention test/build/UI keywords.
- Atomically accounts for mixed code/UI Bash calls and rejects every mismatched UI driver in compound commands.
- `trellis-lite update` upgrades known legacy active-task profiles, resets legacy `checker: on` to off, preserves task scope, and leaves unknown/current/archive profiles unchanged.
- Release staging now excludes root `.trellis` data correctly and pushes only the current version tag.
notes: Reload or restart an already-running OMP extension once after update. Historical in-memory counters cannot be reconstructed; subsequent counters persist in .trellis/.runtime/lite-budget/.
